derivation:
by
  simpa only [Surjective, comp_apply, hf.1.eq_iff] using (hf.2.forall (p := fun b => ∃ c, f (g c) = b))
explanation: Specialize surjective quantifier reindexing to the predicate ∃ c, f (g c) = b. Injectivity of f simplifies the reindexed predicate. The candidate's proof is independent of the target.
